mutants.name: edge_graph_no_scc
mutants.desc: greedy chaining: repeatedly start a walk at an uncovered edge with no uncovered predecessor and extend along uncovered edges

mutants.name: euler_formula
mutants.desc: Euler-trail cover count: per weakly connected component, max(1, sum of max(0, out-in)) (assumes each edge used once)

mutants.name: no_transitive_closure
mutants.desc: min path cover on the condensed edge-graph via matching, but WITHOUT transitive closure (vertex-disjoint paths)

mutants.name: sources_sinks
mutants.desc: max(#source SCCs, #sink SCCs) of the letter graph's condensation, summed over weak components
